name: ModelVariant793_HandleRequest
evidence: matching model_variant/variant793_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4 (every period a bolt leaves a model point and flies towards a jittered point on the opposing slot, wrapped in a ring of sprites and spinning Gouraud strips and trailing a ribbon and smoke puffs; the ribbon fades once the bolt arrives. On arrival it flares into a glow with two fans of rays and coloured, fading animated sparks while the ambient light dims and recovers); for a non-negative request it sets the effect up from the command row indexed by the request, otherwise it runs one frame; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the French header-810/907 images build the same source unchanged, at the same addresses; only the resident call targets differ. HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
